tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Apple rapidly releases 3 smart home new products as total market value hits all-time high again. Reported by 36氪: ChaPanda involved in IPO fraud with trading suspended and DeepSeek completing 100 billion yuan financing.
Google launches Gemini 4 with cost-performance ratio that challenges GPT-6 and Opus 5.5. Reported by 爱范儿: Gemini 4 Argon offers powerful artificial intelligence for complex tasks with low-cost API access.
Singapore introduces new initiatives to strengthen artificial intelligence security by establishing the Frontier AI Resilience and Safety Working Group. Confirmed by 富途牛牛: market news covers these strengthened protections.
Compal accelerates time-to-AI deployment with next-generation NVIDIA platforms at OCP Global Summit 2026. Confirmed by FT Markets: NVIDIA's next-gen artificial intelligence technology enables rapid data center deployment.
An engineer at OpenAI was arrested for allegedly installing wiretapping equipment in the office. Confirmed by 京报网: a Saudi engineer faced arrest for installing a hidden listening device.
